HISD Badge

An inline count or status marker attached to another element. Each panel below shows every state. The right panel is forced to data-theme="dark"; the component inherits dark purely through semantic tokens — no component-specific dark CSS. The badge is presentational (aria-hidden) when its value is also in context, and the sole carrier of the count (aria-label="[n] notifications") when it is not.

Count — sole carrier (attached to icon button)

Copy-paste snippet

<!-- Count badge, SOLE carrier: badge holds the only copy of the count,
     so it is labelled. The host button names its own action. -->
<button type="button" class="hisd-badge-host" aria-label="Notifications">
  <span class="hisd-badge-host__icon" aria-hidden="true"></span>
  <span class="hisd-badge" aria-label="3 notifications">3</span>
</button>

<!-- Count badge, PRESENTATIONAL: the value is already in the visible text,
     so the badge repeats it and is hidden from assistive tech. -->
<span>Unread messages <span class="hisd-badge" aria-hidden="true">5</span></span>

<!-- Status badges: the visible text IS the accessible name. -->
<span class="hisd-badge hisd-badge--success">Enrolled</span>
<span class="hisd-badge hisd-badge--warning">Pending</span>
<span class="hisd-badge hisd-badge--info">In review</span>
<span class="hisd-badge hisd-badge--danger">Overdue</span>

<!-- Unread dot (count unknown): always presentational. -->
<span class="hisd-badge hisd-badge--dot" aria-hidden="true"></span>
